previous.changeLog: Improved Exterior loading speed; added Replay Animations for supported animated styles and 3D attachments, with previews generated automatically from installed game files; improved attachment preview updates; reduced unnecessary network-timeout error reports; removed the redundant Exterior Creations shortcut and obsolete configuration-path support.

current.changeLog: Fixed an issue that prevented players from using Apply & Exit when applying a valid style or camouflage to a compatible vehicle.
